deviations.what: sap.m.Carousel.ariaLabelledBy is @since 1.125; the original wires the Carousel to its Title through it, so the association is kept 1:1 and the port needs a UI5 runtime >= 1.125 for the accessibility label.

onResizeCarouselContainer sets carousel.setWidth(value + '%') on every Slider liveChange. The port reproduces it roundtrip-free: the Slider value is two-way bound and the Carousel carries a width expression binding over the same field. The Slider.liveChange attribute is therefore dropped and Carousel.width is added (structural-diff reports attr missing Slider.liveChange and attr extra Carousel.width).

The Slider value -> Carousel width expression binding is client-side model propagation and is unverified in a running system. **e2e-verified 2026-08-22** (nightly e2e interaction, meta/interactions/z2ui5_cl_smpc_app_427.mjs).
